metadata.title: Options & Technical Volatility Screener
metadata.description: Systematic Weekly Income Screener for Cash-Secured Puts & Covered Calls
metadata.strike_heuristics: Put <= Lower Bollinger Band (2 SD), Call >= Upper Bollinger Band (2 SD)

prediction_markets.event: Which price will Apple stock (AAPL) hold above before staying below it, for a full week?
Satya Nadella out as CEO of MSFT by EOY 2026?
Will any 4 of AAPL, AMZN, ASML, GOOG, META, MSFT, NVDA, and TSM lose 60% of their peak value before 2028?
Will Tesla (TSLA) have a dividend of >=0.1% by mid 2027?
Which of these companies will outperform the S&P 500 in 2026?
Will Elon Musk's net worth fall below $150 billion before 2030?
Will NVIDIA release an RTX 5080 Ti?
Will SPCX close at $150.00 or higher on Friday, October 2, 2026? (Closes early)
What will my Zetamac score be in a month?
